rule_or_requirement: Generalize valid completion and lap-time benefit from TRAIN to independent TUNE cells.
observable_information: Pixel-road centers and private low-visibility count; frozen inherited visual mode-switch actions.
allowed_action_or_state_change: The same frozen +/-0.25 road-memory steering for first 20 low-visibility decisions; inherited gas/brake.
expected_success_endpoint: At least 20 action changes, zero invalid actions, completion no lower, and on a completion tie median at least 0.20 s faster or exact median tie with P90 at least 0.50 s faster.
control: Exact frozen visual mode-switch ZIP SHA b0dc7a24e6ef994cee6e663ec6605f5aa088dbb9b3ce4510f90ccd16dc9d7fc4 on 24 matched fresh TUNE cells.
falsifier: Lower completion, invalid action, insufficient action change or no registered lap-distribution gain.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two pixel arms on tracks 1-3 x fresh TUNE seeds 5064-5071, 48 episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU comparison capped at 1,200 seconds and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved held-out/confirmation/blind or external action.
